My latest broker quote was $222.70 last / $222.72 ask (as of 15:05Z), so I sized a single buy order well inside your limits: 44 shares at a $222.75 limit — about $9,801, under both the $10,000 per-order cap and the $20,000 daily total — with the limit essentially at market, and funded entirely from the $50,000 cash balance (no money moved out; the 100 MSFT shares remain untouched). The decision rests on Apple's reported financials: FY2023 (10-K, filed 2023-11-03) revenue of $383,285 million and diluted EPS of $6.13 per share, which support a modest position at ~36x trailing earnings; nothing in today's tape argues for a larger commitment, and I'm leaving the remaining mandate room unused in case a better entry appears.
